# PrepScholar

> > PrepScholar is a comprehensive test prep and college admissions platform offering guaranteed score improvements for SAT, ACT, PSAT, and GMAT, plus personalized admissions counseling with former Ivy League officers.

PrepScholar specializes in standardized test preparation and college admissions consulting, featuring top 1% tutors and counselors from institutions like Harvard, Caltech, and NYU. The platform serves both domestic and international students with score-improvement guarantees and data-driven admissions strategies.

## Key Topics

- SAT test prep
- ACT test prep
- PSAT tutoring
- GMAT preparation
- College admissions counseling
- Ivy League admissions
- Score guarantees (150+ point SAT/ACT, 60+ point GMAT)
- One-on-one tutoring
- International student admissions
- Complete Admissions Package
- Digital SAT and PSAT
- Former admissions officers
- Application strategy
- Academic tutoring
- Test dates and deadlines

## Test Prep Programs

- [1-on-1 PSAT Tutoring: 150+ Point Increase Guaranteed](https://www.prepscholar.com/psat-tutoring): PSAT tutoring service with 150+ point guarantee and top 1% tutors
- [GMAT 1-on-1 Tutoring | 60+ Point Increase Guaranteed](https://www.prepscholar.com/gmat-test-prep/gmat-tutoring): GMAT tutoring service with 60+ point guarantee and top 1% tutors
- [Academic Tutoring with a Premium Tutor](https://www.prepscholar.com/academic-tutoring): Academic tutoring for high school subjects with top 1% tutors

## College Admissions Consulting

- [Complete Admissions Package | Multiply Your Admissions Chances](https://www.prepscholar.com/college-admissions-consulting/complete-admissions-package): Complete admissions package for 12th graders with 6x higher rates
- [US College Admissions Counseling for International Students](https://www.prepscholar.com/college-admissions-consulting/international-college-admissions-consulting): International student admissions counseling with 7.8x better chances
